data.name: Saad
data.gender_notes: Saad is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d), 'to be happy, fortunate'. Saʿd means 'good fortune'. Its root is س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d). A common companion name; e.g. Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ. Saad is a Arabic name meaning “Good fortune; happiness; auspiciousness”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saad expresses “Good fortune; happiness; auspiciousness”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d), 'to be happy, fortunate'. Saʿd means 'good fortune'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saad total 7, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
